message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && ls src/.libs/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; which hb-shape hb-fuzzer 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls test/shaping/fonts/ 2>/dev/null | head` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The fuzzer takes a font file as input. The last 64 bytes of the input are used as UTF-32 text to shape. So the PoC is a font file where the last 64 bytes encode Arabic text with combining marks that trigger `reorder_marks_arabic`.

The crash is a use-of-uninitialized-value in `merge_out_clusters` reading `out_info` entries that are uninitialized. This happens when `reorder_marks_arabic` calls `merge_out_clusters(start, j)` where `j` exceeds `out_len`.

Let me build the fuzzer to reproduce. Let me first check if there's a prebuilt binary or if I need to build.
